pair_attestations.reason: Re-read merge-base.bpmn against the merge-main.yml change (bean o8s9). The change is to the per-PR merge job's concurrency key only: cancel-in-progress is now trigger-dependent so a push sweep queues rather than cancels. The diagram asserts nothing about concurrency or which of two runs survives — it describes the merge/classify/regen/commit path and its two committing gateways, all unchanged. Prose still holds.
